---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new model version, data tool, or documentation improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve? What experiment or hypothesis does it enable?

## Proposed Approach

If you have a specific implementation or algorithm in mind, describe it here. Include relevant references (papers, public Kaggle notebooks, etc.) if applicable.

## Scope

- [ ] New model version (notebook)
- [ ] Data / preprocessing improvement
- [ ] Evaluation / metric improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI / tooling
- [ ] Prototype / visualization

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you considered and why you are proposing this one instead.

## Additional Context

Any other context, benchmarks, or diagrams that would help evaluate this feature.
